messages.text: Hi Jess! Me and my partner Jacopo would be super interested in this! We have jobs starting on Monday in Brisbane and are looking for a place. We can provide landlord references and friend references to prove we are fun and easy to live with! :) would be happy to do a FaceTime/in person viewing :)
Also, I’m British and jacopos Italian , we are on a working holiday visa, let me know if I can tell you anything else about us!
